text:
maria: quick update on microfuse-6b int6 bring-up — smoke pass finished, curious about routing recs

dan: nice, numbers?

maria: latency p50 ~ 45ms, p95 ~ 210ms on 8k batch window, tokens/sec ~ 650, cost/unit ~ $0.0046 per 1k tokens (est)

sanjay: how does that compare to int8 baseline?

maria: int8 baseline p50 42ms p95 180ms tokens/sec 700 cost $0.0068 per 1k tokens

olivia: so int6 buys ~32% cheaper per token but p95 tail regressed ~+30ms, any quality deltas?

maria: ran GTN shortform evals (1000 samples): answer-accuracy drop ~0.9% absolute on reasoning set, hallucination up on code snips (tiny)

dan: 0.9% might be okay depending on product SLAs — where did hallucination spike? examples?

maria: mainly multi-step code patches, e.g. loop off-by-one — sample attached in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/mf6b-int6-samples (note: redacted)

ops-bot: deploy-candidate microfuse-6b-int6 smoke -> metrics: latency_tail_up, cost_down, error_rate stable

sanjay: propose phased routing: 20% traffic to int6 for non-code flows, 100% fallback to int8 for detected code prompts, expand if no regression in 1 week

olivia: what detection rule for code? current heuristics: prompt contains "```" or keywords (def, class, import, SQL, SELECT) — should we tune?

dan: add probabilistic classifier: if code_prob > 0.6 route to int8, else int6. We have a cheap ngram model for that already.

maria: agree. Also recommend limiting max_tokens to 1024 on int6 for now (to keep KV cache stable).

sanjay: need a scorecard before rollout — suggested columns: slice, metric (acc, hallu, latency p95, cost per 1k), delta vs int8, acceptable threshold, routing rule

maria: I'll produce quick CSV and post tomorrow. Quick checklist for product/GTN: 1) approve 20% non-code shadow routing 2) enable auto-fallback if hallucination signal > threshold 3) add canary alert on p95 +10% and hallucination +1.5%

olivia: product note: GTN should prepare messaging: "cost-optimized tier with identical API; high-assurance flows will keep fidelity tier"

dan: ops TODO: add rollout flag microfuse-int6-canary, implement classifier routing, set monitoring dashboards (latency by model variant, hallucination-rate, fallback-rate)

maria: one more datapoint — quantization artifacts visible in token-level perplexity on long-contexts (>1024) so we should keep that cap until int6 matures

sanjay: timeline: implement routing/tune classifier this week, start 20% non-code canary Mon, evaluate after 7 days, then expand to 50% if stable

olivia: +1 to timeline. I'll sync with GTN to update pricing buckets and product docs.

dan: thanks team. maria post the CSV + one-pager and we'll ship ops checklist. :thumbsup:
